A Symphony of Tradition: The Global Percussion & Violin Summit
Immerse yourself in a melodious journey with "Echoes of Tradition: A Global Percussion & Violin Summit". Scheduled to take place on the 18th of October, 2026, this awe-inspiring event will encompass a blend of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and multilingual classical music. Experience the beauty of live music in concert, as tradition meets innovation in this unique summit. The harmonious rendezvous is sure to capture the hearts of music lovers and create an unforgettable evening.
Artists of Resonance: The Virtuosos Behind the Melody
The artists gracing the stage at this event are renowned for their exceptional talent and skill. Their mastery over their respective instruments and profound understanding of classical music transcends boundaries, bringing together listeners from diverse linguistic backgrounds. Their performances, steeped in tradition yet infused with a contemporary spirit, resonate with audiences of all ages and tastes. Get ready to be swept away by their captivating performances.
Matchbox4: The Heartbeat of Houston's Art Scene
Set in the vibrant heart of Houston, Texas, the event will take place at Matchbox4, a part of the MATCH - Midtown Arts and Theater Center Houston. Located at 3400 Main St, this venue is not just a hub for the arts but a symbol of cultural diversity in the United States. With its prime location, safety measures, and accessibility, it is a favored destination for art enthusiasts. Add to your enriching experience by exploring nearby attractions or indulging in a meal at one of the many Indian restaurants in the vicinity.
Secure Your Seat: Ticket Details
Experience this musical extravaganza live by securing your tickets today. We offer a range of tickets to suit different preferences. The $82 Level tickets are priced at $82.00 for those seeking a premium experience. For those on a budget, the $57 Level and $37 Level tickets are available at $57.00 and $37.00 respectively. Book your tickets now and embark on a musical journey like no other.
